تعتمرين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَمِرِينَ (taʕtamirīna) /taʕ.ta.mi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# تُعْتَمَرِينَ (tuʕtamarīna) /tuʕ.ta.ma.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
